[[File:Raining_frogs.gif|thumb|A [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] weather report indicating possible [[frog rain]]]]
'''Frogs''' were [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibians]], widely known as good jumpers. They lived in the [[Water/Legends|watery]] environments of various [[Planet/Legends|planets]], including [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. Occasionally, entire swarms of frogs [[Frog rain|rained down]] from the skies of a planet. Various species, both sentient and non-sentient, were metaphorically referred to as "frogs."

==Biology and appearance==
Frogs were [[Color/Legends|green]]-skinned,<ref name="HNN" /> hopping animals with a short body, protruding [[Eye/Legends|eyes]],<ref name="SME" /> four [[Limb/Legends|limbs]]<ref name="HNN" /> and a long [[Tongue/Legends|tongue]] that could flick in and out of their [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]] quickly.<ref name="DS" /> Frogs lived in large groups gathered in [[Water/Legends|watery]] areas such as pools and streams. On the world of [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], a cold [[Planet/Legends|planet]] exposed to electrical storms, frogs were a common prey of the [[mookla]]s and [[pittin]]s.<ref name="COTJ" /> Sometimes, entire swarms of frogs seemed to "[[Frog rain|rain]]" from a planet's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]].<ref name="HNN" />

Metaphorically, several creatures were also called "frogs," including the [[Gorg/Legends|gorgs]]<ref name="JJM">''[[Jar Jar's Mistake]]''</ref> or the [[Worrt/Legends|worrts]], both species from [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="DS" /> Some [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibians]] like the [[Rybet/Legends|Rybet]] were also said to be "froglike,"<ref name="JS">''[[Jedi Search]]''</ref> and the [[Serp]]s from [[Serphidi/Legends|Serphidi]] were sometime called "frog-mouth."<ref name="SW64">[[Star Wars (1977) 64|''Star Wars'' (1977) 64]]</ref> When the young [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] from [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], first met the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] named [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]], he initially called him "the frog man" before finding out his identity.<ref name="TPMJA">''[[Star Wars Journal: Anakin Skywalker]]''</ref> [[Nick Rostu]] once called his enemy [[Kar Vastor]] a "frogswallower"&mdash;among other colorful epithets.<ref name="SP">[[Shatterpoint (novel)|''Shatterpoint'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[George Lucas]] refused to ever identify [[Yoda's species/Legends|Yoda's species]], but has jokingly said Yoda was a frog. In the documentary "From Puppets to Pixels," Lucas called Yoda "the illegitimate child of [[Wikipedia:Kermit the Frog|Kermit the Frog]] and [[Wikipedia:Miss Piggy|Miss Piggy]]."<ref name="Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones">DVD bonus disc of [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']]: "From Puppets to Pixels"</ref>
